## Pull request overview

This PR completes a large set of ROADMAP items by adding broad accessibility/performance/robustness test coverage across Console and key plugins, plus a new `InlineEditing` component in `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and a couple of build/type fixes.

**Changes:**
- Add extensive new Vitest suites for accessibility, performance benchmarks, view robustness, and field/widget edge cases across Console + plugins (grid/kanban/calendar) + components.
- Introduce `InlineEditing` in `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and export it from the package entrypoint.
- Apply small type/build fixes in `SchemaRenderer` error boundary rendering and `data-objectstack` security audit filtering.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 26 out of 26 changed files in this pull request and generated 12 comments.

The `disabled` prop is only enforced when entering edit mode; once in edit mode the input/buttons are only disabled while `saving`. If `disabled` is true (or becomes true) while editing, the user can still modify and save/cancel. Consider disabling the input and action buttons when `disabled || saving`, and optionally auto-exiting edit mode when `disabled` becomes true.

This test file defines and tests a local `useViewSwitcher` implementation instead of exercising any production view-switching logic. As written, it will pass even if the real grid/kanban/calendar view switching code regresses. Consider moving the hook/state-preservation logic into the package source (or importing the real implementation) and testing that instead.

`id="inline-editing-error"` is hard-coded, so rendering multiple InlineEditing instances will produce duplicate IDs and incorrect screen reader associations (and `aria-describedby` will point at the wrong element). Use `React.useId()` (or similar) to generate a per-instance error id and reference that from `aria-describedby`.

This test suite renders hard-coded markup and asserts Tailwind classes on it, rather than rendering the actual console layout components. That means it won’t catch regressions in the real layout implementation and can provide false confidence. Consider rendering the real Sidebar/Header/Layout components (with mocks as needed) and asserting on their classnames/structure instead.

Repo guidance calls for English-only UI strings in code. This test introduces non-English literals (e.g., Japanese/Chinese/Russian) in component text. If Unicode coverage is desired, consider isolating it to i18n-focused tests or using escaped Unicode with an English explanation to stay consistent with the repo’s language policy.

Repo guidance calls for English-only UI strings in code. This test introduces a non-English literal (`مرحبا بالعالم`). If RTL/Unicode coverage is desired, consider isolating it to i18n-focused tests or using escaped Unicode with an English explanation to stay consistent with the repo’s language policy.

For `type="number"`, `Number(editValue)` will coerce `''` to `0` and non-numeric input to `NaN`, which can silently save unintended values. Consider treating empty input as `null` (consistent with other numeric fields) and handling `NaN` as a validation error before calling `onSave`.
